---
bibliography: references.bib
csl: https://www.zotero.org/styles/chicago-author-date
citeproc: true

lang: en-US
number-sections: false
format-links: false

format:

  # ============================================================
  # PDF — LATEX / XELATEX
  # ============================================================

  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    documentclass: article
    fontsize: 12pt
    papersize: letter
    mainfont: "Times New Roman"

    indent: true
    block-headings: false

    geometry:
      - margin=1in

    hyperrefoptions:
      - hidelinks

    keep-tex: true

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{setspace}
        \usepackage{fancyhdr}
        \usepackage{titlesec}
        \usepackage{indentfirst}

        % ========================================================
        % BODY
        % ========================================================

        \doublespacing

        \setlength{\parindent}{0.5in}
        \setlength{\parskip}{0pt}

        % ========================================================
        % PAGE NUMBERS
        %
        % Title page:
        %   no visible number
        %
        % First actual text page:
        %   Arabic page 1, upper right
        % ========================================================

        \setlength{\headheight}{15pt}

        \pagestyle{fancy}
        \fancyhf{}
        \fancyhead[R]{\thepage}

        \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
        \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

        \fancypagestyle{plain}{
          \fancyhf{}
          \fancyhead[R]{\thepage}
          \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
          \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}
        }

        % ========================================================
        % FIVE-LEVEL HEADING SYSTEM
        %
        % Level 1 = centered, bold
        % Level 2 = centered, regular
        % Level 3 = flush left, italic
        % Level 4 = flush left, regular
        % Level 5 = run-in, italic, terminal period
        % ========================================================

        \titleformat{\section}[block]
          {\normalfont\normalsize\bfseries\centering}
          {}
          {0pt}
          {}

        \titleformat{\subsection}[block]
          {\normalfont\normalsize\centering}
          {}
          {0pt}
          {}

        \titleformat{\subsubsection}[block]
          {\normalfont\normalsize\itshape}
          {}
          {0pt}
          {}

        \titleformat{\paragraph}[block]
          {\normalfont\normalsize}
          {}
          {0pt}
          {}

        \titleformat{\subparagraph}[runin]
          {\normalfont\normalsize\itshape}
          {}
          {0pt}
          {}
          [.]

        % ========================================================
        % HEADING SPACING
        % ========================================================

        \titlespacing{\section}
          {0pt}
          {\baselineskip}
          {\baselineskip}

        \titlespacing{\subsection}
          {0pt}
          {\baselineskip}
          {\baselineskip}

        \titlespacing{\subsubsection}
          {0pt}
          {\baselineskip}
          {\baselineskip}

        \titlespacing{\paragraph}
          {0pt}
          {\baselineskip}
          {\baselineskip}

        \titlespacing{\subparagraph}
          {0pt}
          {\baselineskip}
          {0.5em}

        % ========================================================
        % BLOCK QUOTATIONS
        %
        % Single spaced internally.
        % 0.5-inch left indent.
        % Same 12-point type.
        % ========================================================

        \renewenvironment{quote}
          {
            \par
            \addvspace{\baselineskip}
            \begin{singlespace}
            \begin{list}{}{%
              \setlength{\leftmargin}{0.5in}%
              \setlength{\rightmargin}{0in}%
              \setlength{\topsep}{0pt}%
              \setlength{\partopsep}{0pt}%
              \setlength{\parsep}{0pt}%
              \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}%
            }
            \item\relax
          }
          {
            \end{list}
            \end{singlespace}
            \par
            \addvspace{\baselineskip}
          }

        % ========================================================
        % REFERENCES
        %
        % 0.5-inch hanging indent.
        % CSL controls spacing between entries.
        % ========================================================

        \setlength{\cslhangindent}{0.5in}

        \renewenvironment{CSLReferences}[2]
          {\begin{list}{}{%
            \setlength{\itemindent}{0pt}%
            \setlength{\leftmargin}{0pt}%
            \setlength{\rightmargin}{0pt}%
            \setlength{\parsep}{0pt}%
            \setlength{\topsep}{0pt}%
            \setlength{\partopsep}{0pt}%
            \ifodd #1%
              \setlength{\leftmargin}{\cslhangindent}%
              \setlength{\itemindent}{-1\cslhangindent}%
            \fi%
            \setlength{\itemsep}{#2\baselineskip}%
          }}
          {\end{list}}

  # ============================================================
  # MICROSOFT WORD
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  #
  # cmos-reference.docx MUST be in the same directory.
  #
  # Create a Pandoc reference file initially with:
  #
  # quarto pandoc -o cmos-reference.docx \
  #   --print-default-data-file reference.docx
  #
  # Then modify its styles in Word.
  #
  # REQUIRED WORD DOCUMENT SETTINGS
  #
  # Page:
  #   Letter, 8.5 x 11
  #   1-inch margins
  #
  # Header:
  #   Different First Page = ON
  #   first-page header = empty
  #   normal header = page number right aligned
  #
  # Numbering:
  #   arrange numbering so physical page 2 displays Arabic 1
  #
  # Normal:
  #   Times New Roman
  #   12 pt
  #   double line spacing
  #   first-line indent = 0.5 inch
  #   0 pt before
  #   0 pt after
  #
  # Body Text:
  #   same as Normal
  #
  # First Paragraph:
  #   same as Normal
  #
  # Heading 1:
  #   TNR 12
  #   bold
  #   centered
  #   double spaced
  #
  # Heading 2:
  #   TNR 12
  #   regular
  #   centered
  #   double spaced
  #
  # Heading 3:
  #   TNR 12
  #   italic
  #   flush left
  #   double spaced
  #
  # Heading 4:
  #   TNR 12
  #   regular
  #   flush left
  #   double spaced
  #
  # Block Text:
  #   TNR 12
  #   single spaced
  #   left indent = 0.5 inch
  #   no first-line indent
  #
  # Bibliography:
  #   TNR 12
  #   single spaced
  #   hanging indent = 0.5 inch
  #   one blank line between entries
  #
  # CMOS Title:
  #   TNR 12
  #   regular
  #   centered
  #   double spaced
  #   no indent
  #   approximately 2.67 inches before
  #   approximately 2.67 inches after
  #
  # CMOS Title Info:
  #   TNR 12
  #   regular
  #   centered
  #   double spaced
  #   no indent
  #
  # CMOS References Heading:
  #   TNR 12
  #   regular
  #   centered
  #   single spaced
  #   no indent
  #   approximately two blank lines after
  # ============================================================

  docx:
    toc: false
    reference-doc: cmos-reference.docx

  # ============================================================
  # OPENDOCUMENT / LIBREOFFICE
  #
  # Content and page breaks will work.
  #
  # For exact ODT styling, use the same approach as Word with:
  #
  # reference-doc: cmos-reference.odt
  #
  # ============================================================

  odt:
    toc: false

  # ============================================================
  # HTML
  # ============================================================

  html:
    toc: false
    theme: default
    mainfont: "Times New Roman"
    fontsize: 12pt
    linestretch: 2
    page-layout: article

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>

        html,
        body {
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          line-height: 2;
          color: black;
          background: white;
        }

        main.content,
        #quarto-content {
          max-width: 6.5in;
          margin-left: auto;
          margin-right: auto;
        }

        p {
          margin-top: 0;
          margin-bottom: 0;
          text-indent: 0.5in;
        }

        /* TITLE PAGE */

        .cmos-title-page {
          box-sizing: border-box;
          min-height: 9in;
          padding-top: 2.67in;
          text-align: center;
          break-after: page;
          page-break-after: always;
        }

        .cmos-title-page p,
        .cmos-title-page div {
          text-indent: 0;
        }

        .cmos-paper-title {
          margin: 0 0 2.67in 0;
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: normal;
          line-height: 2;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .cmos-paper-info {
          margin: 0;
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: normal;
          line-height: 2;
          text-align: center;
        }

        /* HEADINGS */

        h1,
        h2,
        h3,
        h4,
        h5 {
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          line-height: 2;
          color: black;
          border: none;
          padding: 0;
          margin-top: 1em;
          margin-bottom: 1em;
        }

        h1 {
          text-align: center;
          font-weight: bold;
          font-style: normal;
        }

        h2 {
          text-align: center;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: normal;
        }

        h3 {
          text-align: left;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: italic;
        }

        h4 {
          text-align: left;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: normal;
        }

        h5 {
          text-align: left;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: italic;
        }

        /* BLOCK QUOTATIONS */

        blockquote {
          margin-top: 1em;
          margin-bottom: 1em;
          margin-left: 0.5in;
          margin-right: 0;
          padding: 0;
          border-left: none;
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          line-height: 1;
          color: black;
        }

        blockquote p {
          text-indent: 0;
        }

        /* REFERENCES */

        .cmos-references-heading {
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: normal;
          line-height: 1;
          text-align: center;
          margin-top: 0;
          margin-bottom: 2em;
        }

        #refs,
        #refs .csl-bib-body {
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          line-height: 1;
        }

        #refs .csl-entry {
          margin-left: 0.5in;
          text-indent: -0.5in;
          margin-top: 0;
          margin-bottom: 1em;
        }

        </style>

  # ============================================================
  # EPUB
  # ============================================================

  epub:
    epub-title-page: false

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>

        body {
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          line-height: 2;
        }

        p {
          margin-top: 0;
          margin-bottom: 0;
          text-indent: 0.5in;
        }

        .cmos-title-page {
          min-height: 9in;
          padding-top: 2.67in;
          text-align: center;
          break-after: page;
          page-break-after: always;
        }

        .cmos-title-page p,
        .cmos-title-page div {
          text-indent: 0;
        }

        .cmos-paper-title {
          margin-bottom: 2.67in;
          text-align: center;
          line-height: 2;
        }

        .cmos-paper-info {
          text-align: center;
          line-height: 2;
        }

        h1,
        h2,
        h3,
        h4,
        h5 {
          font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
          font-size: 12pt;
          line-height: 2;
          margin-top: 1em;
          margin-bottom: 1em;
        }

        h1 {
          text-align: center;
          font-weight: bold;
        }

        h2 {
          text-align: center;
          font-weight: normal;
        }

        h3 {
          text-align: left;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: italic;
        }

        h4 {
          text-align: left;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: normal;
        }

        h5 {
          text-align: left;
          font-weight: normal;
          font-style: italic;
        }

        blockquote {
          margin-left: 0.5in;
          margin-right: 0;
          padding: 0;
          border: none;
          line-height: 1;
        }

        blockquote p {
          text-indent: 0;
        }

        .cmos-references-heading {
          text-align: center;
          line-height: 1;
          margin-bottom: 2em;
        }

        #refs,
        #refs .csl-bib-body {
          line-height: 1;
        }

        #refs .csl-entry {
          margin-left: 0.5in;
          text-indent: -0.5in;
          margin-bottom: 1em;
        }

        </style>

  # ============================================================
  # TYPST PDF
  # ============================================================

  typst:
    papersize: us-letter
    mainfont: "Times New Roman"
    fontsize: 12pt
    linestretch: 2

    margin:
      top: 1in
      bottom: 1in
      left: 1in
      right: 1in

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        #show heading.where(level: 1): set align(center)
        #show heading.where(level: 1): set text(
          size: 12pt,
          weight: "bold",
          style: "normal"
        )

        #show heading.where(level: 2): set align(center)
        #show heading.where(level: 2): set text(
          size: 12pt,
          weight: "regular",
          style: "normal"
        )

        #show heading.where(level: 3): set text(
          size: 12pt,
          weight: "regular",
          style: "italic"
        )

        #show heading.where(level: 4): set text(
          size: 12pt,
          weight: "regular",
          style: "normal"
        )

        #show heading.where(level: 5): set text(
          size: 12pt,
          weight: "regular",
          style: "italic"
        )

---

<!-- ============================================================
TITLE PAGE — LATEX PDF
=============================================================== -->

::: {.content-visible when-format="pdf"}

```{=latex}
\begin{titlepage}

\thispagestyle{empty}

% Title approximately one-third down the physical page.

\vspace*{0.30\textheight}

{\centering

Your Paper Title\par

% Purdue says the identifying information should appear
% "several lines later."
%
% Eight double-spaced baselines is being used as a visual
% implementation of the sample, not as an independent
% Chicago rule.

\vspace{8\baselineskip}

Your Name\par
Course Number: Course Name\par
Month Day, Year\par

}

\end{titlepage}

% First page of actual text = page 1.

\setcounter{page}{1}
```

:::

<!-- ============================================================
BODY
=============================================================== -->

Start writing your paper here. Normal body text is 12-point Times New
Roman, double-spaced, with one-inch margins in paged document formats
and a half-inch first-line paragraph indent.

A standard Chicago 18 author-date citation looks like this
[@smith2024, 42].

Another source can be cited like this [@jones2022, 220].

For a narrative citation, @smith2024 [42] argues that the evidence
supports this interpretation.

This is another paragraph so you can verify ordinary paragraph
indentation and line spacing.


<!-- ============================================================
LEVEL 1
Centered
Bold
Headline-Style Capitalization
=============================================================== -->

# Contemporary Literature

This demonstrates a Level 1 heading.


<!-- ============================================================
LEVEL 2
Centered
Regular
Headline-Style Capitalization
=============================================================== -->

## What Are the Major Movements?

This demonstrates a Level 2 heading.


<!-- ============================================================
LEVEL 3
Flush left
Italic
Headline-Style Capitalization
=============================================================== -->

### Beat Generation

This demonstrates a Level 3 heading.


<!-- ============================================================
LEVEL 4
Flush left
Regular
Sentence-style capitalization
=============================================================== -->

#### Significant figures, events, and elements

This demonstrates a Level 4 heading.


<!-- ============================================================
LEVEL 5

For reliable visual consistency across PDF, Word, ODT,
HTML, EPUB, and Typst, write Level 5 directly at the
start of the paragraph in italics with a terminal period.

This avoids Word treating Heading 5 as a separate block.
=============================================================== -->

*Kerouac as the leader.* The role of founding Beat Generation poet was
filled by Jack Kerouac. This Level 5 heading remains run-in across the
major output formats.


<!-- ============================================================
BLOCK QUOTATION
=============================================================== -->

# Block Quotation Example

Normal double-spaced body text appears before the block quotation.

> This is an example of a block quotation. A prose quotation of five or
> more lines or more than one hundred words should be blocked. It begins
> on a new line, appears without quotation marks, is indented from the
> left margin, and is single-spaced. [@smith2024, 50]

Normal double-spaced body text resumes here.


<!-- ============================================================
CONCLUSION
=============================================================== -->

# Conclusion

Write your conclusion here.

<!-- ============================================================
CHECKLIST
===============================================================

BODY
- Times New Roman, 12 pt
- 1-inch margins in paged formats
- Double-spaced normal body text
- 0.5-inch first-line indent
- No extra paragraph spacing

PDF PAGINATION
- No visible number on title page
- First actual text page = Arabic 1
- Page number upper right

WORD PAGINATION
- Controlled by cmos-reference.docx
- Different First Page enabled
- Title page header blank
- Subsequent page numbers upper right
- First text page displays 1

TITLE PAGE
- Title approximately one-third down page
- Regular 12-point type
- Not all caps
- Identifying information several lines later
- Eight-baseline PDF gap is a visual implementation choice

HEADINGS
- Level 1: centered, bold
- Level 2: centered, regular
- Level 3: flush left, italic
- Level 4: flush left, regular
- Level 5: run-in, italic, terminal period

BLOCK QUOTATIONS
- New line
- No quotation marks
- Single spaced
- 0.5-inch left indent

REFERENCES
- Heading = References
- Heading centered
- Two blank lines before first entry
- Entries single spaced internally
- One blank line between entries
- 0.5-inch hanging indent
- Chicago author-date CSL handles bibliography formatting

=============================================================== -->
